entries.title: Spelunky Classic

emulation.notes: Use the original Windows freeware build.

primary.why: The original Windows freeware release is the authentic Classic route because it is the source-available 2008/2009 GameMaker version that started the series. Later HD/remake releases are better treated as their own entry because they add multiplayer and remake-level changes.
primary.how_to_play: Download Spelunky Classic from the official Spelunky World original page and run the Windows freeware build.

all_releases.fidelity: Fanmade browser/ChromeOS route based on the original source.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful access route, but the official Windows freeware build is the authentic archival primary.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Classic is best preserved by the original Windows freeware release.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2012/2013 Spelunky HD/enhanced version is treated as a separate entry because it remakes and expands the game rather than merely patching Classic.

entries.title: Spelunky
entries.definitive_edition: Spelunky enhanced remake on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC enhanced release is the best main route for the HD/remake version because it covers the modern remake with PC capture/settings flexibility. Xbox, PlayStation, and Switch ports do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Spelunky on Steam for Windows PC and play the enhanced/remake version. Keep Spelunky Classic separate if Sami wants the original freeware game.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC port of the enhanced remake.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete HD/remake route with PC capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release of the enhanced remake.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically important launch route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: console/portable route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Backward-compatibility route for the Xbox 360 release.
all_releases.reason: skip: access route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: portable route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented for the HD/remake release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this HD/remake release with Spelunky Classic; the original freeware game is tracked separately.

entries.title: Spelunky 2

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best archival route because it covers the full sequel with PC capture/settings flexibility and is part of the crossplay-supported modern platform set. The later Switch, Xbox, and PS5 releases add access options but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Spelunky 2 on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

all_releases.reason: primary: complete route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: portable route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox release across Xbox One and Series X|S.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: access/fidelity route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or content-expanded edition is documented; the PS5 release is a later access route, not a new content edition.
